## Environment (7)

Validated at boot in `@shared/config/env`; a bad value crashes the process.

| Variable                        | Required | Rule                                                                   |
| ------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NODE_ENV`                      | no       | `z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development')` |
| `DATABASE_URL`                  | yes      | `z.string().url()`                                                     |
| `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL`        | no       | `z.string().url().optional()`                                          |
| `WORKSPACE_RESOLUTION_STRATEGY` | no       | `z.enum(['subdomain', 'path', 'header']).default('subdomain')`         |
| `APP_BASE_DOMAIN`               | yes      | `z.string().min(1)`                                                    |
| `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`            | no       | `z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(10).default(1)`                    |
| `LOG_LEVEL`                     | no       | `z.enum(['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error']).default('info')`           |
